body:
Found during the T-PLUGIN-04 real-machine migration (gate-manifest seq 193). In the installed (bundled) plugin, agb doctor reports adlc CLI FAIL: "ADLC executable failed revalidation before spawn: expected package name @adlc/cli but found @adlc/cli-vendored-by-antigravity-booster". resolveAdlcBinary correctly returns Tier 1 (vendor/adlc, spec §4.2, Appendix A D12, A.6 item 12), but execFileAuthenticatedAdlc calls revalidateAdlcBinary, which has no vendored branch and only authenticates an @adlc/cli npm package. Every adlc call (scheduler rails-guard/gate-manifest, review, plan, preflight, prosecute, doctor) therefore fails in the bundled plugin; with active rails agb run fails closed and dispatches nothing. Unbundled tests never spawned the vendored binary through this path.

Fix in lib/adlc-bridge.mjs: revalidateAdlcBinary gains bundled (default IS_BUNDLED) and pluginRoot (default defaultPluginRoot) options, threaded from execFileAuthenticatedAdlc. When bundled, or when the candidate realpath equals <pluginRoot>/vendor/adlc/bin/adlc.mjs, re-run resolveVendoredAdlc(pluginRoot) (all pinned digests) immediately before spawn: absent/tampered -> { ok:false } (fail closed, no fallthrough); in the bundled build any candidate other than the vendored binary is refused. Otherwise the existing npm-package path is unchanged.

Acceptance criteria:
1. New tests in test/adlc-bridge.test.mjs: unbundled run with a plugin root containing the real vendor/adlc spawns `adlc --version` through execFileAuthenticatedAdlc and gets 1.11.1; bundled:true likewise; a tampered vendored file (copy of vendor/ in a temp plugin root, one byte changed) is refused before spawn; bundled:true with a non-vendored candidate is refused; the existing npm-package revalidation tests still pass.
2. Doctor adlc CLI check passes against a temp plugin root with the real vendor/adlc (test/doctor*.test.mjs).
3. `npm test` passes on Node 24 and 22; `npm run build` leaves dist/ and vendor/ unchanged after committing the rebuilt bundles.
4. `adlc rails-guard --base <main> --ticket T-PLUGIN-05-VENDORED-ADLC-SPAWN` exits 0; hollow-test on changed lines has no unexplained survivors; adversarial-review exits 0.
5. After merge, with the owner go-ahead: re-run bootstrap/migrate --force on the owner machine and confirm agb doctor adlc CLI PASS.
title: Spawn-time revalidation accepts the pinned vendored adlc (installed plugin cannot run adlc)
